title: Configure /etc/resolv.conf for systemd-resolved stub mode
summary: Link /etc/resolv.conf to the systemd-resolved stub file so applications that read this file directly use the local DNS resolver.

steps.explain: Create a symbolic link from /etc/resolv.conf to the systemd-resolved stub configuration. This ensures applications reading /etc/resolv.conf use the local stub listener.

verify.expect: Output listing DNS servers (e.g., 127.0.0.53) and search domains for each link

rollback.explain: Remove the symbolic link. You may need to restore a backup of /etc/resolv.conf if you had one.

warnings: Failure to properly configure /etc/resolv.conf will result in broken DNS resolution.
Do not run this command inside an arch-chroot; run it from the host system targeting the mounted root.
